purpose: On an ISOLATED COPY of SherpaAsrBackend.kt, observe the ACTUAL prepared float32 LE bytes (SHA-256 + sample count) BEFORE native decode, so the parent can compare the SDK session/orchestration hypothesis against a direct native Whisper hypothesis for the PUBLIC unsliced Mandarin clip2006. Production source is unchanged.
reversal: On the isolated copy: source.replace(old,new) applies the single diagnostic; source.replace(new,old) restores the exact original. old occurs exactly once; new does not contain old; the 8 leading spaces of the original expression line stay in the file and belong to NEITHER old NOR new, so both directions are exact inverses.

fingerprintFile.name: odai-native-parity-prepared.txt
fingerprintFile.format: one line of text: preparedFloat32LeSha256=<64 lowercase hex>|preparedSampleCount=<int>
fingerprintFile.float32LeSha256Definition: java.nio.ByteBuffer.allocate(n*4).order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN); putFloat for each sample; SHA-256 of buffer.array(); lowercase hex
fingerprintFile.durability: written and flushed via FileOutputStream.use (close); the observed values are ALSO durably recorded in the exclusive AtomicFile report

constraints: keep model.verify() and WhisperSpeechGate.prepare(model, samples); do NOT bypass or change the real VAD gate
observe the prepared array BEFORE returning it to native decode (SherpaSession zeroes waveform in its finally)
fully qualified java.* types inside the expression; no new production imports or dependencies
the callback must NOT reference any test/instrumentation-only class from main code
exclusive file creation (absent-before required); no raw PCM or waveform persisted
one SDK call + one direct native call only; no third decode, retry, new model, or scoring change

replacements.target: the single FILE-path transcribe expression (NOT the microphone recognize() -> session.transcribe(request.locale) { ... capture() } path)
